messages:
Lina: live from the all-hands chat — instant standing ovation from my desk :clap: :clap:
Sam: who brought the vuvuzela? because i'm hearing one in spirit :vuvuzela: :grin:
Jules: lol not me, but i'll bring kazoo 2.0 next time :kazoo: (patent pending)
Priya: shoutout to the snacks team, those mini donuts were a move :donut: :heart_eyes:
Kai: can we start a poll: pastries vs. bagels? use reactions, I will tally (low effort democracy)
Marta: pastries :raised_hands:
Theo: bagels for life :bagel: (everything with shmear)
Nora: pastries for carbs, bagels for commitment. this is the real strategic decision of the quarter 
Lina: @ops-bot tally please :eyes:
ops-bot: poll results: pastries 4, bagels 3 — winner: pastries :tada:
Sam: confetti GIF incoming: https://giphy.com/gifs/confetti-party-12345 (10/10 would confetti again)
Jules: also, karaoke afterparty? i will resurrect my ukulele if there's interest :microphone:
Priya: i will duet with you but only if you play something recognizable :laughing:
Kai: request: anything but the one song Jules played at offsite 2019. my ears are still in recovery
Marta: quick office logistics: meetup near 3rd floor kitchen in 10 mins for donuts. first come first glaze.
Theo: i'll be the judge of glaze quality. this is a solemn vow.
Nora: tiny poll: sound effects for next all-hands intro — options: (A) vuvuzela, (B) ambient bacon sizzle, (C) whale call
Lina: A+ for chaos, C for dramatic entrances, B for immediate hunger
Sam: whale call, please. dramatic and slightly ominous :whale:
Jules: added to playlist. also, for the record: massive kudos to the product demo team, that demo actually made me laugh out loud :clap::clap:
Priya: same. animation of the bouncing robot was adorable. can we make that the screensaver?
Kai: next all-hands agenda item: unofficial emoji tier list. i'll start a doc.
Marta: note: who wants coffee? i'm doing a run. reply here and i will judge your caffeine needs on sight :coffee:
Theo: double espresso. judge wisely.
Nora: one oat latte pls xoxo
Lina: last note — someone gif-raid the CEO with puppy pics pls :puppy: :pray:
Sam: on it. opening folder `puppies_final_2025` now:
```
/puppies_final_2025/
  - otis_sleeping.jpg
  - panda_outfit.gif
  - loaf_bark.mp4
```
Jules: perfect. morale secured. :sparkles:
ops-bot: thread archived for all-hands reactions log (meta: lighthearted, non-work banter)
